findings.description: No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects in this bucket are stored unencrypted by default rather than protected via SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS.

findings.issue_category: missing access control / public access block
findings.description: No ACL or public access block is set for this bucket, leaving it reliant on AWS defaults; combined with no bucket policy restricting access, this could allow broader access than intended.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for a bucket storing ledger export data, leaving sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
The bucket lacks a server_side_encryption_configuration block, so model artifacts are stored without encryption at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so operational runbooks (which may contain sensitive operational details) are stored unencrypted.

The ACL value 'lcatalogopts-delivery-write' is not a valid canned ACL; if this is intended to be a permissive/log-delivery ACL it may grant broader write access than necessary and should be reviewed, as malformed or overly permissive ACLs on an audit trail bucket risk tampering with security logs.
force_destroy = true allows the bucket and all its contents to be deleted without recovery, removing a safeguard against accidental or malicious data loss for archived reports.
force_destroy = true permits irreversible deletion of ledger export data, risking loss of financial records that may be required for audit or compliance purposes.

findings.issue_category: force_destroy enabled on audit log bucket
findings.description: force_destroy = true on the audit trail bucket allows deletion of security audit logs, undermining the integrity and availability of the audit trail required for incident investigation and compliance.

findings.issue_category: plaintext sensitive data upload without encryption enforcement
findings.description: The uploaded vendor roster object does not specify server-side encryption (kms_key_id or server_side_encryption) and is placed in a bucket lacking default encryption, so potentially sensitive vendor data is stored in plaintext.
